auth.title: Sign in to GOGG
auth.description: Use Google to create or access your GOGG account. This does not automatically link a Riot account.
auth.googleNotConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured in this environment.
auth.privacyNote: GOGG uses only the Google account identifier and basic profile needed to establish your session. It never receives your Google password.
auth.sessionUnavailable: We could not verify your session. Please try again.
auth.errorCancelled: You cancelled Google authorization. You can try again.
auth.errorExpired: This sign-in attempt expired. Please start again.
auth.errorGeneric: Google sign-in failed. Please try again later.
auth.signOutFailed: The server could not revoke your session. Please try again.
